public_rationale: Reported OpenAI losses give the concern a factual basis, but they do not establish that generative AI prices generally failed to cover sustainable provision. The available API analysis points toward positive direct margins, while acknowledging that its estimates remain unverified. Neither source supplies the matched costs, revenues and provider coverage needed for this claim.
limitations: Company-wide annual forecasts are not quarterly service margins.
The claim leaves its accounting basis and industry coverage unspecified.
The API estimate is a model, not disclosed financial results.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI is extremely expensive and unsustainable at the prices currently charged.

statement.excerpt: And, more worryingly, they're building all of these tools on top of generative AI, which is extremely expensive and, as I've argued, unsustainable at the rates being charged.

from_speaker: unsustainable at the rates being charged
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that prevailing prices did not cover the costs of sustainably providing generative AI services.
For the ongoing financial condition, use April–June 2024, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication. September prices would also need to be matched to the relevant services.
Sustainable provision includes operating costs and an appropriate allocation of model development costs. Corporate losses alone do not establish that service prices were inadequate.
The claim names neither individual providers nor an accounting basis. Evidence about one provider cannot establish an industry-wide conclusion.
criteria.support_condition: Representative, comparable provider records show that revenues at the relevant prices failed to cover sustainable service-provision costs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative, comparable provider records show that revenues at those prices covered sustainable service-provision costs.

evidence.locator: First article paragraph after the photograph
evidence.explanation: This supports concern about OpenAI's overall economics, but describes projected annual losses rather than realized quarterly service margins. CNBC relied on a confidential source and said it had not seen the financial statements.

evidence.locator: Original August 2024 analysis, paragraph following Key Takeaways
evidence.explanation: The model estimates positive API margins after GPU costs, challenging an inference that every service was sold below its running cost. Its dated 2026 self-assessment explicitly says the estimates remain unverified; it also excludes costs needed to establish full sustainability.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Comparable 2024 provider records showing revenue and fully defined provision costs at the relevant prices, with sufficient coverage to assess the general claim.
